steps.en: Install the package and serve a model on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with tool calling
steps.zh: 装好包，用支持工具调用的 OpenAI 兼容接口起一个模型

steps.en: Run a Harbor task with the CLM agent and a context budget
steps.zh: 用 CLM agent 跑一个 Harbor 任务，给定上下文预算

steps.en: Before every command, mirrors the conversation to a file and nudges as the budget fills
steps.zh: 每条命令前把对话写成一个文件，预算越满提醒越急

steps.en: The model rewrites stale turns in that file with ordinary shell tools
steps.zh: 模型用普通 shell 工具改写文件里过时的轮次

steps.en: Parses the file back into messages, keeps system prompt and task pinned, gates the edit
steps.zh: 把文件解析回消息列表，钉住系统提示和任务，过一道编辑闸门

steps.en: Compare task score and cost across runs from each trial's logs
steps.zh: 从每次 trial 的日志里对比得分和花费

value.en: The model decides what stays in its window — no hand-written truncate-or-summarize rule — and every run's cost is logged in USD or FLOPs
value.zh: 窗口里留什么由模型自己定，不用手写截断或总结规则，每次运行的花费按美元或 FLOPs 记账

sources: https://github.com/facebookresearch/context-language-models README Getting started (pip install -e .; clm-harbor run -p <harbor-task> -a clm-minimal -m openai/<model>)

clm/clm_harness/README.md How a turn works (mirror to /tmp/.live_ctx/LIVE_CTX_MAIN.txt, budget nudges at 25/50/75%, edits with sed, python3 or cat >, read back, pinned system prompt and task, edit gate) and Outputs (usage.json, trajectory.ctx.json)
clm/clm_harness/README.md Serving (any OpenAI-compatible server, tool calling must be enabled)
